name: Performance
intent: Preserve the source console's native-class rendering load and maximize emulator frame-time headroom without reconstructing from below-native resolution.

technical_basis.source_reference: Nintendo Switch 1 docked output up to 1920x1080 at 60 Hz
reasoning: 1.0x preserves the source game's intended docked-class internal scale instead of degrading below native by default.
1080p output matches the Switch 1 docked output ceiling and minimizes presentation overhead.
Bilinear is the lowest-overhead general scaling path.
No additional AA is forced, preserving maximum GPU headroom and avoiding redundant post-processing.
Game-specific overrides may still use 0.75x + FSR when a particular title is unusually demanding.
